fixes.what: The phone branch shows only a ~24px sliver at the left edge (shift 56px, art-stop = gutter-24+shift). Either show a real tip (set --art-stop to calc(var(--gutter) - 8px + var(--phone-shift)) and the mask fade to 12px so ~40px of leaf and fruit are visible) or hide it on phones entirely.
fixes.why: At 390px the sliver reads as a rendering smudge, not a painted frame (phone shots 1–3).

fixes.what: Offset the two branches: keep left at top:25vh, move right to top:38vh and scale it to 0.9 (width clamp(200px,23vw,470px)); keep both masks.
fixes.why: Two identical-height, identical-size branches read as mirrored clip-art; an asymmetric pair reads as a composed painting (desktop shots 1–3).

fixes.what: Replace the native box: appearance:none; width:18px;height:18px;border:2px solid var(--brown);border-radius:2px;background:transparent; :checked{background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red)} with a cream check glyph via ::after; keep accent-color as fallback.
fixes.why: Unchecked native checkboxes are white squares with grey borders on the cream paper, the only off-palette element on the page (desktop shot 3).

fixes.where: site.css · .field input,.field textarea,.field select{border:1px solid var(--brown)}
fixes.what: Use border:2px solid var(--brown) (or 1.5px at 85% brown) so inputs match the 2px weight of every rule, button, window and poster frame.
fixes.why: The 1px input borders are the one hairline in a system built on 2px kashida lines; the form reads lighter than the brand.
On iPhones the English tagline sits under the home indicator at 2vh (17px); the first impression's last line is half hidden.

fixes.what: Drop the 1px shadow line (box-shadow:none); let the cream bar meet the cream page with no rule, or use the brand's 2px red rule only on inner pages' .site-header--solid.
fixes.why: A faint 1px full-width line under the header is the one grid hairline on an otherwise rule-free cream page (desktop shots 1–4).
